empire.name: Crown Imperium
empire.blurb: The seawalls hold the Black Tide back, and the Crown asks a great deal of you to keep them standing.
empire.motto: Through trade, duty, and discipline, a safer world.

alliance.name: Free Confederacy
alliance.blurb: Every captain elected, every share counted on deck, and the Moot argues about everything else.

neutral.name: Unaligned Isles
neutral.blurb: Islands that have not picked a side, and would rather not.
